## Overview

Version 4.0 represents a complete architectural overhaul of the Information Manipulation Taxonomy, transitioning to a Quarto-based website with improved navigation, search, and cross-referencing capabilities.

## Major Changes

### Website Architecture
- Migrated from standalone HTML to Quarto website framework
- Implemented dynamic listing pages for Functions, Mechanisms, Terrain, and Channels
- Added responsive grid layouts with color-coded sections
- Integrated search functionality across all content

### Content Organization
- 9 strategic Functions
- 99+ documented Mechanisms
- 7 Structural Terrain factors
- 8 Channel Types
- Cross-referencing between Functions and their associated Mechanisms

### Design
- Professional color scheme aligned with InfoEpi.org branding
- Improved typography and spacing
- Enhanced mobile responsiveness
- Consistent styling across all pages

## Data Source

All content is now generated from authoritative CSV files:
- `function.csv` - Function definitions and mappings
- `mechanisms.csv` - Mechanism descriptions and function associations
- `terrain.csv` - Terrain factors
- `channel_types.csv` - Channel type definitions
- `examples.csv` - Documented real-world examples

## Next Steps

Future updates will be documented in this changelog, making it easy to track additions, modifications, and refinements to the taxonomy.
